state:
Goal `core-zip`: `Core\Zip::entries` is complete (`bun nv proofs --id 'Core\Zip::entries'` prints `complete.`), and `Core\Zip` has its class card.
The attack on `entries` found a hang: the repeated-name check scanned every earlier entry, so 100,000 entries never finished listing. `directory` now keeps a `HashSet` of the names it borrows from the archive (module doc § *What this spends*).
`read` and `extract` still owe examples, hostile, perf and a Rust test with a `covers:` marker. Their three `.nvst` cases already exist.

next.title: Feature proofs for the rest of `Core\Zip`

items.text: **`Core\Zip::read`** — owes about, examples, hostile, perf, a Rust `// covers:` test (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/zip.rs:150`, member body `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/zip.rs:994`. Use the test module's `listed` helper as the pattern for driving the member through `nvs_runtime::call`, and `Archive::record` in the `entries` attack for building archives with `Core\Bytes::pack`. The attack should target the bound: a deflate bomb, a `maxBytes` of 0, and a ratio just over its limit.

**`Core\Zip::extract`** — owes about, examples, hostile, perf, a Rust `// covers:` test. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/zip.rs:167`, member body `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/zip.rs:1039`. It needs `fs.write` and `fs.read` granted for the destination: read the capability door comment at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs:2793` before writing an example.

backlog: `Core\Zip`'s three member cards (`ENTRIES_DOC`, `READ_DOC`, `EXTRACT_DOC` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/zip.rs`) are in the dense internal voice, not the voice of AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*. Goal `plain-comments` owns that sweep.

Listing 5 entries costs 22 allocations (`docs/perf/members.ndjson`), because each `Entry` owns a `String` beside the `NvsStr` the member returns. This is a possible perf slice, owned by the module doc of `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/zip.rs`.
